title: Strategy Roundtable playbook & follow-ups
content:
Purpose: quick-playbook + question set I can use running the exec staff strategy roundtable. Focus: capacity commitments (Dedicated), private deployment roadmap, and short-term cost/latency tradeoffs to report up. This is a working scratchpad — will prune before the meeting.

Top outcomes I want from the meeting:
- Decide whether to accelerate Dedicated capacity commit to Q2 (yes/no + $ target).
- Agree on one prioritized ask to Security & Compliance for Private onboarding (scope + timeline).
- Lock a rollout policy for model fallbacks (which variants, who owns runbook).

Agenda (20m total):
- 0–3m: Quick status — cost/latency snapshot (Marcus)
- 3–10m: Dedicated capacity ask: proposal + risk tradeoffs (me)
- 10–16m: Private deployment checklist: legal/security open items (Nina)
- 16–20m: Decisions, owners, and 1–3 concrete next steps (all)

Prep notes / talking points (bullet style):
- Cost snapshot (short): Hosted API unit cost is down 12% last month due to batching config changes; QPS tail still spikes 2–3x during release windows. We need reserved capacity to control peak unit cost and latency SLOs.
- Proposal: Reserve 120 A100-equivalent GPUs for Redwood Dedicated, phased: 60 in May, +60 in July. Expected committed monthly spend: ~$420k. Key benefit: 35% lower peak token cost and 2–8x improvement on p95 latency for long-turn tasks.
- Risks: longer commit = capital lock, utilization ramp risk if PLG growth stalls. Mitigations: staged commit + automatic burst to hosted; 4-week pilot with guaranteed termination clause in contract.
- Private deployment ask: prioritize KMS integration + audit log retention. Current blocker: legal needs a canonical data flow diagram and proof of HSM integration. Ask: Product to deliver diagram + security to sign off within 3 weeks.
- Rollout policy: default -> quantized variant (fast) -> full-precision fallback when quality thresholds breached. Who owns: Serving Runtime for ops, Product for quality gates.

Open questions to surface (for CTO/Head of Eng):
- Are we comfortable committing 12 months on Dedicated, or prefer 6 months with auto-renew?
- For Private, do we accept customer-managed KMS only, or require both CMK + Redwood CCM at launch?
- Do we enforce model pinning at the tenant-level at GA or permit global model upgrades with tenant opt-out?

Concrete data to show (one-slide bullets):
- Current p95 token latency (hosted): 380ms; Dedicated pilot (test infra): 120ms
- Average unit cost per 1k tokens hosted: $0.83; projected with Dedicated: $0.54
- Customer churn risk metric: 4 customers flagged for SLA sensitivity (list in linked doc)

Draft decisions I will propose verbally:
- Approve staged Dedicated commitment of 120 GPUs with 6-month minimum, review after 8 weeks. (Decision owner: CFO + Head of Infra)
- Prioritize KMS + audit log work for Private; Product deliver DFD + compliance checklist by 2026-04-01. (Owner: Product & Security)
- Adopt rollback-first rollout policy (canary -> auto-fallback) and assign Serving Runtime to own the runbook. (Owner: Serving Runtime)

Follow-up action tracker (post-meeting items I will own or delegate):
- A1: Draft term-sheet for staged Dedicated commit (send to CFO + legal). Owner: Aisha. Due: 2026-03-20.
- A2: Product: create private-deploy DFD + KMS integration spec and share with Legal. Owner: Nina. Due: 2026-04-01.
- A3: Serving Runtime: prepare rollback runbook + test matrix for canary/fallback. Owner: Marcus. Due: 2026-03-30.
- A4: Growth: identify top 10 customers impacted by p95 latency; schedule outreach. Owner: Jordan. Due: 2026-03-24.
- A5: Finance: model cashflow impact of staged commit and show worst-case/expected utilization. Owner: CFO (cc: Aisha). Due: 2026-03-22.

Notes-to-self (things to mention casually):
- Mention that Optimize team has two quick wins on batching config that reduce cost by ~6% without quality impact — good PR for selling commit.
- Remind execs that Dedicated gives deterministic latency (valuable for regulated customers) — tie to sales pipeline.
- Bring up possibility of an early-customer pilot for Private (one customer, closed NDA) to accelerate compliance artifacts.

Potential pushbacks and counters:
- "Too much upfront spend" -> propose staged commit + emergency burst to hosted to cap downside.
- "We don't have proof of utilization" -> show PLG growth signals + GA usage projections + pilot utilization report.

Meeting logistics notes:
- Bring a single slide with the 3 metrics (p95 latency, unit cost delta, top-customer list).
- Keep ask crisp: dollar number + 2-line rationale.
- If decision deferred, capture who will reconvene and when (hard: 1 week).

Post-meeting email template (quick send after meeting):
- Subject: Actions from Strategy Roundtable — Dedicated + Private
- Body (short): Thanks all — summary of decisions, owners, and due dates. Please flag any errors within 24 hours. Attaching term-sheet + DFD link.

Random TODOs to clean before finalizing slides: 
- Pull exact A100-equivalent pricing and format in table (Finance).
- Export pilot latency traces for Marcus's slide.
- Add one-liner for sales pipeline mapping to justify commit.

End of scratchpad. Keep this doc as the single source for the meeting ask. I will prune and convert to an email + 1-slide deck before sending.
